name: n8n
summary: Workflow automation platform combining AI agents and integrations.
description: n8n is a workflow automation platform that combines AI agents with hundreds of app integrations and custom code, giving technical teams the flexibility of code with the speed of no-code. Its differentiator is that it can be self-hosted (free Community Edition) as well as used in the cloud. Cloud plans come with a free trial.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Cloud plans come with a free trial.
